summary: Frontend-only E2E test of the Dispatch Challan → Sales Invoice rework, logged in as admin/admin123 on the preview URL. WORKING: The sidebar shows 'Sales Invoice' and no longer shows 'Dispatch Challan'. The page title is correct. Legacy records DC-2026-001..004 show in Total Sales as 'Dispatched' and in Total Dispatched marked 'legacy challan'. All 4 cards show qty and amount, and clicking a card switches inv-list-title and the table. Period filters (All, This Month, Last Month, 3m, 6m, Custom from/to) change the card numbers correctly. SO mode: selecting SO-2026-029 auto-fills the customer (select disabled), SO Qty/Invoiced/Balance, HSN 8504 and rate 150000. Invoice numbers use settings.invoicePrefix: AE-2026-001. Over-balance qty is blocked with an alert. A second partial invoice is limited to the remaining 6, and a fully invoiced SO drops out of the SO list. Creating an invoice did not change stock. Dispatch: default qty = balance. A partial dispatch of 2 created DSP-2026-001 with vehicle/driver/LR/ack, the status became 'Partial 2/4' and Pending showed the remainder. Over-balance dispatch is blocked. The second dispatch set the status to 'Dispatched' and hid the Dispatch button. FG stock was clamped at 0 (did not go negative). Edit blocks reducing qty below the dispatched qty, and the SO select is disabled after a dispatch. The view modal shows items and dispatch history. Direct mode (Raw Material, RADIATOR KEY, stock 4): creating the invoice did not change stock. Dispatching 5 was blocked ('only 4.00 Nos in stock'). Dispatching 3 left stock at 1, dispatching 2 more was then blocked, and dispatching 1 left stock at 0. Deleting the invoice restored stock to 4 (checked in Mongo). Deleting a dispatch keeps the invoice and reverts its status to Partial. Prints download PDFs (AE-2026-001.pdf, DSP-2026-002.pdf) containing HSN, CGST/SGST split, amount in words, and the Dispatch Note details. Regression: Sales Orders and Dashboard load without errors, and Document Format types include 'Sales Invoice' (checked in code and in DB). BUGS: (1) DSP numbers are duplicated after a dispatch is deleted. (2) Invoice numbers are duplicated after an invoice is deleted. (3) Ready for Dispatch 'Invoice' pre-fills qty 0 on every line, and Est. Value is ₹0, because job card product names don't exactly match SO item names. (4) Editing an invoice on a multi-line SO silently adds the un-invoiced lines at full balance. (5) The Sales Invoice print header shows placeholder company data (Jaipur address, GSTIN 08AAGCA1234L1ZP, dummy HDFC bank) from the migrated 'Delivery Challan' document format, while CGST/SGST vs IGST is decided from settings.gst 09AARCA0588P1ZR. (6) Some deletes made in one session were not saved and the deleted invoices came back after re-login; a race in the store's sync polling is the likely cause (not proven). All test data was cleaned up, and stock and invoices are back to their original state.

ui_bugs.issue: nextNumber('DSP', all) is count-based (count+1). After deleting DSP-2026-001 while DSP-2026-002 existed, the next dispatch got DSP-2026-003, which was already used, so two rows share the same number and the same data-testid (inv-dispatch-row-DSP-2026-003). Reproduced.

The invoice number is also nextNumber(prefix, count+1). After deleting AE-2026-001 while AE-2026-002 existed, the New Sales Invoice form suggested AE-2026-002, which already exists. A legal invoice series must be unique. Fix: use max(seq)+1 for the year (or a stored counter).

inv-ready-create-JC-2026-008 opens the form with SO-2026-012 and JC-2026-008 selected, but all 11 line qtys are 0 (Grand Total ₹0). InvoiceForm.soLines matches si.name === preset.product exactly: JC product '11 kV CT PT Metering Unit 40/5A' vs SO item '11 kV CT PT Metering Unit 40/5 A'. All 3 ready rows have this mismatch (JC-016 '...1-1-1A STMK' vs '...1-1-1A', JC-007 '15/5A' vs '15/5 A'). The same name match makes the Ready Est. Value ₹0.00 (Challans.tsx line 65 soi lookup).

soLines(edit.salesOrderId, edit.items): for SO lines not in the saved invoice, qty defaults to the full balance (ex undefined, no preset → bal). Repro: on SO-2026-022 (2 lines × 24), invoice line0=2 and line1=0 → save → Edit shows line1=24. Clicking Update silently invoices 24 extra units. Legacy DCs have the same problem: DC-2026-001's item name differs from the SO-2026-014 item, so editing it would add 412 units. Fix: when editing, default non-existing lines to 0.

integration_issues.issue: The printed invoice header shows 'Plot No. 42, Industrial Area, Jaipur…', GST 08AAGCA1234L1ZP, info@amrest.in | +91 98765 43210, bank 'HDFC A/C 000000000000', a 'Header Note' and terms 'Goods received in good condition' from the migrated document format df-delivery-challan (seed placeholder data). The Dispatch Note and Settings use the real Bulandshahr address and GSTIN 09AARCA0588P1ZR, and intra/inter-state (CGST/SGST vs IGST) is computed from settings.gst (09). A tax invoice with the wrong supplier GSTIN is a compliance problem. Fix the migrated Sales Invoice format data, or don't let placeholder format values override company settings.

integration_issues.flow: Whole-DB sync (store.tsx polling) — probable data loss
integration_issues.issue: In one session I deleted AE-2026-001..004; the UI showed 0 AE rows, but after re-login all 4 invoices and their dispatches were back in Mongo. The backend log showed 'GET /api/erp/state' in the middle of a run of PUTs. Probable RCA: the 15s poll reads the version while a debounced PUT is in flight (before localVersion += 1 runs), sees v > localVersion, refetches, and setDb(remote) overwrites newer local changes; the next setDB (e.g. log()) then PUTs the stale snapshot. localVersion also ends up 1 ahead of the server. A second, slower cleanup run (3s between deletes) did persist. Not fully proven, but serious for a stock ledger.

issues: Legacy invoices have rate 0, so Total Sales/Dispatched amounts show ₹0.00 for them (a data gap; consider a note or using the SO rate).
Dashboard subtitle still says 'click a month to view DCs'; rename to invoices/dispatches.

action_items: Make DSP and invoice numbering unique: use max existing sequence for the year + 1 instead of count + 1 (lib/utils.ts nextNumber is shared; consider a maxSeq variant).

Ready for Dispatch: link the JC to the SO line with a normalized/fuzzy name match (trim, collapse spaces, case-insensitive, remove spaces before 'A'), or fall back to the single SO line / let the user pick. Apply the same fix to the Est. Value rate lookup.
InvoiceForm edit: SO lines not present in the saved invoice should default to qty 0, not the full balance (soLines when existing is passed).

Fix the Sales Invoice document format: the migrated df-delivery-challan carries placeholder Jaipur address, GSTIN 08AAGCA1234L1ZP and dummy bank. Make the print header GSTIN match the GSTIN used for the CGST/SGST vs IGST decision.

Harden store.tsx sync: skip the poll refetch while a save is pending or in flight; set localVersion from the PUT response's version instead of +=1; don't overwrite local state that has unsaved changes.
Minor: when a dispatch is deleted, revert the SO status from 'Delivered' and the JC status from 'Completed'. 3m/6m ranges use toISOString (UTC) while other ranges use local dates.
critical_code_review_comments: nextNumber count-based numbering → duplicates after deletes (affects invoices and DSP; data-testids become non-unique).
InvoiceForm.soLines edit path defaults missing lines to the full balance.

Name-based joins (SO item ↔ JC product ↔ Item Master ↔ dispatch lines) are fragile. dispatchedOfLine matches by name, so an invoice with two lines of the same item name would double count. Use itemId or line index.

DispatchModal computes 'all' (for numbering) from the closure db, not from d inside setDB. Fine for a single user; combined with whole-DB last-writer-wins sync, two users dispatching at the same time get the same number and one user's changes are lost.
removeDispatch/removeInvoice don't revert SO 'Delivered' / JC 'Completed' statuses set by DispatchModal.

success_rate.frontend: ~80% (13 requested scenarios: 10 fully pass; Ready-for-Dispatch prefill fails; print and edit only partially pass)

seed_data_creation: Created AE-2026-001/002 (SO-2026-029), AE-2026-003 (direct RM RADIATOR KEY), AE-2026-004 (SO-2026-022) plus dispatches DSP-2026-001..003. All deleted; RADIATOR KEY stock restored to 4, DTR 100 kVA stock 0 (unchanged). Mongo erp_state version 593 at end.
context_for_next_testing_agent: State lives in Mongo collection erp_state, _id 'amrest-main', field data (read-only inspection with pymongo using backend/.env is handy for checking stock). Login inputs are input[name='amrest-login-username'/'amrest-login-password']; navigate with get_by_role('button', name='Sales Invoice', exact=True). invoicePrefix='AE'. Container date is 2026-10-16. Useful data: SO-2026-029 (id 182b3643-..., 1 line DTR 100 kVA ×10 @150000); SO-2026-022 (id 30a0fc2d-..., 2 lines) for the multi-line edit bug; RADIATOR KEY (id 75d7f047-d780-4e46-a78c-45335f8b4b7f, RM, stock 4) for direct stock tests. Print uses html2canvas + jsPDF: capture text with a MutationObserver on body for nodes with style.left='-10000px'; PDFs download as <number>.pdf. Wait about 3s between data mutations, and re-verify in Mongo after re-login because of the sync race.
rca of the issue: Duplicate numbers: utils.nextNumber returns count of numbers containing the year + 1. Ready prefill qty 0: InvoiceForm.soLines line 41 uses si.name === p.product, and the JC product strings differ from the SO item strings. Edit over-invoicing: line 41 falls back to 'bal' when ex is missing and no preset. Wrong print header: the seeded 'Delivery Challan' DocumentFormat (address/GST placeholders) was renamed to 'Sales Invoice' by migrateDB, and professionalDocument prefers format fields over settings. Lost deletes: likely the version-poll vs debounced-save race in store.tsx lines 197-231.
